info.name: IBANforge API
info.description:
IBAN validation, BIC/SWIFT lookup, Swiss clearing and compliance risk scoring — for AI agents and developers.

## Getting started
1. The **Demo** request needs no key — run it first to check the collection works.
2. For the paid endpoints, set the `apiKey` collection variable. Get a free key (200 requests/month) by calling `POST /v1/keys/generate {"email":"you@company.com"}`, or buy prepaid credits at https://api.ibanforge.com/#pricing
3. Beyond the free tier, calls are pay-per-use in USDC via the x402 protocol — see https://api.ibanforge.com/.well-known/x402

OpenAPI: https://api.ibanforge.com/openapi.json · MCP server: `npx -y ibanforge-mcp`

request.description: A free, no-auth sample validation. Run this first to confirm the collection and base URL are working.
Validate one IBAN and enrich it: BIC/SWIFT, country, issuer type (EMI / digital bank / vIBAN signal), SEPA + VoP reachability, risk indicators, and Swiss BC-Nummer for CH/LI accounts. Cost: $0.005.
Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call — ideal for CSV cleanup or pre-flight payout-list triage. Cost: $0.002 per IBAN.

item.name: Look up a BIC / SWIFT code

request.description: Resolve a BIC/SWIFT code (8 or 11 characters) into bank name, country, city, LEI and branch info. Backed by 121k+ BIC entries (refreshed monthly). Cost: $0.003.

Pre-flight compliance triage before a SEPA / cross-border payment: sanctions screening (OFAC / EU / UN), FATF jurisdiction flag, SEPA Instant reachability, VoP participation. Returns a 0-100 risk score. Cost: $0.02.

Resolve a Swiss BC-Nummer / IID (1-5 digits) into institution name, type, SIC, euroSIC and QR-IID. Backed by 1,100+ SIX BankMaster entries with full payment-rail participation (SIC, euroSIC, CHF instant) and QR-IID — the deepest Swiss clearing data in any public API. Cost: $0.003.
